name: Neutre / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A single close dry tendon rip followed by a sharp bone crack, a compact wet snap and three soft blood droplets. Restrained organic gore foley, quick physical limb detachment. Not an impact landing.
